messages:
maya: FYI customer reports streaming responses cut off after ~45s, client reconnects and triggers immediate retry loop — they see partial text then reconnects keep generating duplicate tokens billed. ticket: https://support.example/t/4201 :grimacing:

sam: can you paste a short trace? connection id / request id?

maya: convo from customer included this snippet from client console:
```
SSE: event:data id=12345
data: {\"choices\": [\"The answer pa\"}

// then connection closed, reconnect and gets the same partial chunk again
```

jordan: likely an idle drop from our edge or customer's proxy. ALB idle timeout is 60s but this cuts ~45s — could be intermediate proxy. any chance client is behind mobile carrier NAT?

maria: two quick things to clarify: TCP keepalive != app-level keepalive. TCP keepalive helps only at kernel level and typically has very long intervals. For SSE we recommend application comment pings or explicit `ping` events every 10-15s.

sam: also watch last-event-id handling. If client reconnects without sending `Last-Event-ID` header it may re-request from start and server might replay partial chunk state. that could explain duplicate billing.

maya: customer says they do send `Last-Event-ID` but we don't see it in our ingress logs for the failed reconnects. ingress shows new connection with no last-id.

maria: then server can't dedupe. solution options:
- emit `: keepalive\n\n` comments every 15s from server so proxies don't idle-drop
- require clients to send idempotency token + Last-Event-ID on reconnects
- track connection-level `last_sent_chunk_idx` and refuse replay if reconnect delta is < 2s

sam: also add quick guard on billing: if we see repeated token consumption for same request id within a 30s window, suppress double-charge and mark as suspected-retry.

jordan: quick repro for infra team: run loadtest with a proxy that has 30s idle timeout and simulate chunked outputs with small intervals. I've got a script.

maya: customer asked for patch or workaround ASAP. any quick patch we can push?

maria: short-term: enable app-level comment pings on the affected model route and lower the SSE chunk flush interval so clients get more frequent small chunks (reduces long idle gaps). also add logging to capture `Last-Event-ID` header at ingress layer.

sam: I'll open a canary rollout to add `:keepalive\n` every 15s for the route and extra ingress header logging. deploy-bot will post once canary is live.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for route `model-stream-prod` (3/10 hosts). Monitoring latency and error rates.

jordan: also add a small client-side backoff recommendation in support reply: on reconnect, wait randomized 200-800ms before retry and send `Last-Event-ID`. prevents tight retry loops.

maya: will send customer steps + ask them to validate after we flip canary. I'll include the backoff snippet and ask for network path (carrier/proxy) details. :+1:

maria: long-term infra note: instrument per-connection `last_activity` and emit `connection_warm` metrics; if a connection is idle > X but not closed by server, treat as likely proxy drop and proactively send a small comment ping more often.

sam: added ticket to infra backlog for ingress-level `Last-Event-ID` log + dedupe hook: INFRA-9123

maya: thanks team. will update customer now and mark as escalated.

maria: fwiw here's a minimal server snippet for SSE comment pings (node express):
```js
res.write(': keepalive\n\n'); // send every 15000ms
```

maya: perfect. follow-up: customer also reported billing spike of ~4x over 1hr window — will include that in billing dispute if we detect retry pattern.

sam: note: add metric `streaming.retry.duplicate_tokens` and alert if rate > 0.5% of tokens per minute.

maya: closing loop once canary verified.
